title: nf-core/hlasomatic pipeline - HLA typing samplesheet schema
description: Schema for pre-computed HLA typing provided with --hla_samplesheet

patient.description: Patient or subject identifier used as the join key to link pre-typed HLA alleles to samples in the main samplesheet
patient.errorMessage: Patient ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

A1.description: HLA-A allele 1 in format HLA-A*02:01:01 or A*02:01:01
A1.errorMessage: HLA-A allele 1 must be provided and cannot contain spaces

A2.description: HLA-A allele 2 in format HLA-A*02:01:01 or A*02:01:01
A2.errorMessage: HLA-A allele 2 must be provided and cannot contain spaces

B1.description: HLA-B allele 1 in format HLA-B*07:02:01 or B*07:02:01
B1.errorMessage: HLA-B allele 1 must be provided and cannot contain spaces

B2.description: HLA-B allele 2 in format HLA-B*07:02:01 or B*07:02:01
B2.errorMessage: HLA-B allele 2 must be provided and cannot contain spaces

C1.description: HLA-C allele 1 in format HLA-C*07:01:01 or C*07:01:01
C1.errorMessage: HLA-C allele 1 must be provided and cannot contain spaces

C2.description: HLA-C allele 2 in format HLA-C*07:01:01 or C*07:01:01
C2.errorMessage: HLA-C allele 2 must be provided and cannot contain spaces

A1_PGROUP.description: P-group designation for HLA-A allele 1 (e.g. A*02:01P). Optional.
A1_PGROUP.errorMessage: HLA-A allele 1 P-group cannot contain spaces

A2_PGROUP.description: P-group designation for HLA-A allele 2 (e.g. A*02:01P). Optional.
A2_PGROUP.errorMessage: HLA-A allele 2 P-group cannot contain spaces

B1_PGROUP.description: P-group designation for HLA-B allele 1 (e.g. B*07:02P). Optional.
B1_PGROUP.errorMessage: HLA-B allele 1 P-group cannot contain spaces

B2_PGROUP.description: P-group designation for HLA-B allele 2 (e.g. B*07:02P). Optional.
B2_PGROUP.errorMessage: HLA-B allele 2 P-group cannot contain spaces

C1_PGROUP.description: P-group designation for HLA-C allele 1 (e.g. C*07:01P). Optional.
C1_PGROUP.errorMessage: HLA-C allele 1 P-group cannot contain spaces

C2_PGROUP.description: P-group designation for HLA-C allele 2 (e.g. C*07:01P). Optional.
C2_PGROUP.errorMessage: HLA-C allele 2 P-group cannot contain spaces

normal_sample.description: Normal sample identifier that produced this HLA typing result. Optional; used for provenance tracking.
normal_sample.errorMessage: Normal sample name cannot contain spaces

use_for_patient_level_genotype.description: Flag indicating whether this row should be used for patient-level genotype aggregation. Optional.
